metaDescription: AI-guided strain and pathway design for production you can scale.
heroTitle: AI-guided strain and pathway design for production you can scale.
heroDescription: We apply generative and predictive models to metabolic pathway design, strain optimization, and host engineering helping teams re-engineer microbial or cell-line factories for higher titers, novel products, or more sustainable bioprocesses, with in silico screening before committing to a fermentation run.
capabilities: Metabolic pathway design and flux modeling for target products
Strain optimization for titer, yield, and process robustness
Host engineering across common industrial and cell-line chassis
In silico screening to prioritize designs before fermentation runs
relatedText: Strain and pathway designs are typically validated with variant and mutation-effect prediction.
